outcome: Doppler findings (umbilical artery changes, notch positivity in bilateral uterine arteries, pulsatility indices, oligohydramnios)
cohort: Outpatient pregnant women aged 18-45 years, between 20-32 weeks gestation, without specific infections (Toxoplasmosis, Rubella, Cytomegalovirus, hepatitis, HIV), with low risk for genetic disease/malformation in first trimester screening, and no pathologic findings on detailed ultrasonography, who were categorized into FGR and healthy control groups.
finding: Maternal serum amphiregulin (AR) levels were not significantly different between women with early-onset fetal growth restriction (FGR) and healthy controls, and did not predict early-onset FGR disease or Doppler findings.
mod_finding: There was no significant association between maternal serum amphiregulin (AR) levels and mode of delivery.
